batting.name: P Simran Singh
batting.dismissal: c Ishan Kishan b Arshad Khan

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: st Ishan Kishan b PP Chawla

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c MW Short b R Dhawan

batting.name: Ishan Kishan
batting.dismissal: c R Dhawan b Arshdeep Singh

batting.name: C Green
batting.dismissal: c RD Chahar b NT Ellis

batting.name: SA Yadav
batting.dismissal: c Arshdeep Singh b NT Ellis

balls.text: ends the over with well-executed yorker on the stumps, which is dug out towards long-on. They pinch two to end the innings
flays at this length ball wide of off, as the deep-third fielder chases it to his right
yorker length, and wide of off. Flat-batted to a wide deep third. It has been a good over so far
full toss on off, and smacked to long-on. Not much timing there

high full toss, and the swing from Livingstone drops just short of the long-on fielder rushing and diving forward. Now PBKS review for a potential above-waist no-ball. Replays show the ball was again dipping, and would have passed below the waist
gets an inside edge, as he tries to swing at this very full ball launched just outside off. The ball trickles off his pad towards point
yorker on middle at 152kph and drilled wide of long-off

too high, and too quick. Five wides to add to the tally. But MI have challenged the wide decision. It landed short on middle and leg, and angled across to keep going on top of off. Livingstone tried to pull, and the ball, as the third umpire reckons, was passing well over the bat
good length on off, and swung to long-on from the higher side of the bat
yorker length on off, and dragged off the inside half of the bat to a straightish fine leg
three in a row! Short delivery now - as he follows it up after a full delivery - on middle and off, and pulled over long-on again. Massive hit to keep piling on the pressure
length ball, and launched back down the ground! Livingstone making it look very easy, as he cleared his front leg and went bang! Six more
swatted over long-on! Backs away early, and swat-pulls this slower ball, which is short around middle and off. He crashed that hard
change of pace, and he is foxed. Short and wide-ish off, as he tries to hack but misses
a fumble at deep backward square, and they pinch two. Full toss on off, and flicked hard by Jitesh
drilled wide of deep third! He is deep in the crease, and standing well outside off. Opens the bat face to ram that low full toss outside off beyond the point fielder's reach to his left
yorker on off, and he jams that off a low full toss towards deep point
sliced to deep extra cover! A powerful smash, as went inside out and lofted with the open face of the bat. Length ball wide of off, as he clobbered that in the gap to raise his fifty
low full wide-ish of off, and dragged to deep point
length ball, angling across to end wide of off. Launched high, and down towards long-on

falls between the point fielder running back, and deep third running across to his right! Shorter side of a length outside off, as Jitesh swung while trying to go over the leg side. Came off the outside half of the bat, as the ball ballooned
shuffles across early, and Arshad goes full and wide of off. Jitesh opened the bat face to try and guide that, but was beaten by the slower ball
high-ish full toss on middle and off, and cracked back! Four more, and this races away between long-off and long-on
short delivery on middle, as he sways away after shaping to pull. And it's called wide
six down the ground! That went veryyy straight, and quite high too. Length ball angling across to end on off, and Jitesh pumped it back
tries to heave across the line, but can't connect. Length ball angling across to end wide-ish of off, as he bowled at 141kph
change of pace, and this time Livingstone has now answer. Shorter side of a length outside off, as he tries to pull but misses
good length outside off at 117kph, and swatted to long-off
Kishan leaps veryyy high - almost as if he had a ladder - as Archer fires a short ball at 152kph. Called first bouncer, as Jitesh tries to pull this from outside off but is beaten by the extra bounce
short outside off, and swung away to long-on

swat-pulled between deep backward square and deep midwicket! Archer keeps bowling the slower ball, but Livingstone is ready and waiting. Short around off, and while almost getting beaten, he still pulls it away
swats this good length ball wide of long-off after making room, as the ball ends near middle and off

sliced between point and short third! He has the power game, as much as he has the timing and placement. Opens the bat face to this yorker length ball just outside off, and again plays at the last second
good ball. Bowls short at 137kph on leg, as the ball takes off with Livingstone ducking
pumps this length ball down to long-off with great power, as Livingstone has to sway away to his left
short delivery, which angles away to end off. Pulled to fine leg
flashed to deep backward point! Again Arshad goes short and wide of off, and the batter doesn't need a second invitation. This is hacked to point's right
a gentle nudge between point and short third! It was short and wide, and angling across, as Livingstone waited for it before guiding the ball late
again goes short and wide of off. Hacked to deep point
short and wide of off. Slashed to deep point
hits a bar bang beyond long-on! Shimmies down the pitch, and belts this length ball around middle and leg. The ball ricochets off the bar
short around off, and nudged to long-on
makes room, and clubs this good length ball on the stumps to long-off
saw him skipping out, and bowled full and wide of off. Livingstone ended up dragging to deep point

keeps bowling the change-ups... but it's still four. Archer and Rohit are almost fuming. The bowler is shaking his head, as he bowls from back of the hand on a shortish length on leg. It takes off from Jitesh's left thigh, and dribbles away behind the wicket
slower ball. Short outside off at only 114kph. Pulled to deep midwicket, and it's called first bouncer
hard length around off, and swatted to long-off
deep midwicket rushes and dives forward, only for the ball to beat him! Arshad there tumbled towards his left, but couldn't get a hand. Short ball from Archer, as Jitesh pulled hard
wide outside leg. Not a great over by Archer. Good length ball, angling down, and left alone
top edge over short third! Slower ball again, but this was shorter and outside off. Jitesh heaved across the line, and was lucky that the ball went over the fielder
four wide of long-off! The fielder ran and dived to his left, but in vain. Length ball outside off - seemed like a change-up with that release - as Jitesh freely swatted away for four
fires a high full toss on middle, as Livingstone takes his eyes off. The ball nudges away towards square leg. No-ball called for height
full outside off, and he keeps bowling slow to Livingstone. Nudged to long-on
short outside off, shaping to straighten. Cut hard to deep point
full outside off, and again goes slower. Driven to long-on
turns away off a good length to finish outside off. Hacked to deep point

hits off stump! Just 84kph, as Chawla keeps using the variations along with change of pace. He gave this one some loop, and went on a length just outside off. It was the wrong 'un, which turned back in to disturb the off stump, while Short was trying to slog across the line and missed. Beaten by the lack of pace as much as by the turn into him
full on off, and pushed to long-off
the short fine fielder gets a hand after diving to his left, and the ball rolls away wide of him. Yorker length ball angled into leg, and squeezed out well by Short
misfield by Archer at point, and they pinch a single. Short and slower, but wide of off, as he hacked that late

that travels very quickly! Madhwal again attempts the yorker, but just missed his length. The ball landed on a full length while angling into leg, as Livingstone, standing deep in the crease, flicked that over deep square
another inswinging yorker which lands on leg. Swung away wide of long-on after almost losing his balance
very well bowled. A yorker on middle at 137kph, as Livingstone jams it down to long-on
good comeback. Fires a yorker on middle, as it was swinging in. Squeezed back well, and the quality of the ball is spoiled by it being a no-ball
bashed past the bowler! Mid-off was up, and Madhwal went on a good length outside off. Livingstone cleared his front leg, and slammed that back
turns in off a good length to end on middle. Pushed to long-on
ah, what a good-looking guide past the keeper! Short and quite quick outside off, but Livingstone seemed ready. He almost ramped it away
slower, full and wide of off. Flat-batted to cover
turns in sharply off a good length to end on leg. Clipped to short midwicket
full on leg, and hoicked off the inside half of the bat to long leg
full, loopy and slow on off. Hints to turn away, and is driven to deep point
short and wide of off. Looked like it was released from the front of the hand, as Short could swat it to midwicket only
looks to lap this length ball angled in, as it ends outside leg. Wide called, with Short missing
now Livingstone jumps out, and punches this good length ball on off to long-off
fumble by Kartikeya, and he lets the ball through. Short had jumped out and pushed this length ball back
good length just outside off. Punched to deep point
shapes to heave, but has to tuck this length ball on the stumps to deep midwicket off the inside half of the bat
short, and angled in. But turns away to end around off. Punched to long-off
flicks this full and flat ball on off to midwicket
turns away, and keeps low. Very slow at 82kph, and on a good length. Pushed to long-on after adjusting for the low bounce
much fuller on leg, and dragged to long-on
shortish ball, turning in. Punched to long-on

Chawla wins the battle! He lets out a word or two after that wicket too. It was a googly pitching just outside off, and Dhawan was beaten by the variation. Dhawan again chose to skip down to try and disturb the bowler's rhythm, but Chawla went on a length and outside his arc. The ball turned away as Dhawan lately tried to open the bat face to to guide it, but missed. Kishan did the rest
again attacks Chawla! Full and loopy on middle and off, and Dhawan jumps out again to fire that over the bowler's head
nudges this length ball around off towards deep midwicket
length ball on leg, and turning down further. Left alone, and wide called

dropped by short third diving low to his left! It was Archer there. The ball was short and outside off, as Dhawan hacked hard. Archer seemed a second or two late to react, and the ball went trickling away off his hands
slows down again. Bowls on a length on off, and is tucked to long-on
good length on the stumps at 95kph. Punched back
much slower, and shorter on middle. Turns in and takes his pad as he tries to clip
length ball well outside leg. Dhawan still tries to sweep but misses. Wide called
shortish and fired in, angles into leg. Punched to long-on
short and outside off. Turns in a bit, and is hacked to mid-off's left
almost chipped back. Now the googly, as it it slower and on a length on off
turns away off a full length outside off, as his defence takes an outside edge towards short third
pushes this full delivery on off towards mid-off
ah, the long-leg fielder was a good few paces inside the rope, and so that is four. He also overran to his right, as Dhawan swept a full ball on middle
launches him down the pitch! Full and tossed up on the stumps, as Dhawan skips down first ball and lofts over his head
shorter side of a length, and angled into middle. Clipped towards midwicket to keep ticking
change of pace again. Good length on the stumps, and pushed to mid-on
tries to swat at this shortish ball just outside off, but gets it off the bottom half of the bat to cover
slower ball. Quite full, and angling into middle. Pushed to mid-on
good length on fifth stump. Punched to deep backward point
shortish ball on off, and hacked to wide deep third

four behind the wicket! The short-fine fielder dives to his right, but can't get a hand. Much fuller delivery from Arshad, but this was angling into Short's pads. The batter flicked, and sent it racing
clears the square-leg boundary! Arshad keep banging it short around off, but this time Short slaps it away. Rides the bounce, and pulls hard and flat for six
defends this good length ball on off stump but gets an inside edge
again looks to pull this quite short ball just outside off, which is angling in. But it takes the toe-end of the bat towards short third
shorter side of a length on off, and tapped towards point for a hurried single
pulls this good length ball outside off to fine leg
change of pace: this over has seen it all. Good length ball angled into middle, and dabbed to cover
off the inside half of the bat, but four over midwicket. Length ball angled into middle and off, as he swung across the line. Not much timing, but enough for it to go over the fielder
here comes the first bouncer after the yorker. Bangs it short on middle and off, as it rises well enough for Dhawan to miss his attempted ramp

dropped, but wasn't very easy! Green flung his left hand out after Dhawan had pushed down a yorker-length ball on the stumps. The ball was deflected off Green's hand, and went to mid-on's right. David did well to pull it back
some late movement away after pitching on a good length on seventh stump. Dhawan tries to cut but is beaten
bowls a yorker length while angling it into middle. Jammed down by Dhawan

midwicket dives to his right, but can't stop it. Another shortish ball from Arshad, but this one landed on middle and off while angling across. Short transferred weight on to his back foot, and pulled for four
good length ball on leg stump at 142kph. Takes his pad as he misses his flick, and the ball dribbles to point
drives on the bounce to extra cover. Length ball slanted on fifth stump, as he pushes forward with a flat bat

now tickled to the keeper! And Prabh walks back himself. It was almost a carbon copy of the previous ball: short, pitched on middle and off, and angling away from the right-hander. Prabh went for the slash away from his body, trying to reach out for the ball. But the outside edge settled well into Kishan's hands, and at a comfortable height
much shorter ball, angled across for it to end on sixth stump. He flashes but misses
driven wide of mid-off! Another gentle push, and the ball went dribbling away. A yorker-length ball on fourth stump, as Prabh drives down to play it late

crushed to deep extra cover! Very typical of Dhawan: takes a good stride forward to this full ball just outside off, and presents the full face of the bat to drill that to the extra-cover's right. The dive by the latter goes in vain
looks to push at this full ball just outside off, but gets an inside edge
ah, just a soft touch, and the flick goes almost all the way. Full delivery finishing on the stumps after being angled in, as Prabh placed it to the square-leg fielder's left
fumble by the extra-cover fielder, but his touch means the pace is taken off from the ball. Short and outside off, and slashed to extra cover. The ball trickles wide of mid-off to allow two
much shorter in length, but the line is a bit wide of off. Punched to cover-point
fuller side of a length, and slightly wide of off. Left alone, as the ball straightens after pitching

Down the ground and all the way! Full outside off and Varma muscles this straight down the ground to seal victory for Mumbai Indians, who made this chase of 215 look positively easy, despite losing Rohit Sharma in the very first over

Low full toss on middle and leg, Varma flicks this away to deep backward square. Rahul Chahar throws it to the keeper who has a shy at the non-striker's end and misses, but thankfully Sam Curran was in position behind the stumps to stop it from going for four overthrows
Yorker outside leg, Varma backs away and tries to squeeze it out but can only get it onto his foot
Short outside off, David pulls it out to deep square
Slices it over short third and that's four more. Arshdeep goes full and wide and David swings hard at it and it goes over the fielder
Short outside off and David slaps it out straight of mid-off
Goes full on leg and Varma skips out, backs away and digs this out to deep midwicket
Bangs it in short on leg and across David, who stands tall and swats it away to deep midwicket
On a length outside off, Varma drives this out to deep cover
That was a chance. Full on off, David drives this back at Curran who gets his left hand up but the ball doesn't stick
Oh, David gets cheeky as well! Fuller side of good length, pace off, and waits for it to go across him and just dabs it past short third
Over deep square and Tilak Varma is on song here. Full on middle and leg, he gets down and flicks this over square leg. Sails into the second row
Oh, cheeky. So cheeky! Low full toss, with pace off, on leg and he goes across and scoops this over short fine leg
Oh, what a shot! Banged in short but he latches on to it in an instant and swings this over midwicket
On a length on middle and off, Varma looks to pull but it beats him and Jitesh dives for a good take down leg side. He wants to review this, but they decide against it
Back of a length outside off, Varma steers this to backward point

Arshdeep gets Ishan Kishan again! Bangs it in short on off, Kishan looks to hook but picks out deep fine leg, who takes it comfortably. Kishan has had the better of him today, but Arshdeep has the last laugh. Can this wicket turn the tide, though, coming so soon after SKY's dismissal?
Back of a length on off, David swats this away behind square and beats the short fine fielder to his left. First boundary of the match for him
On a length outside off, Kishan cuts to point and gets the single
Full outside off, David miscues it but the ball lands in no-man's land around mid-on and rolls to the fielder in the deep
Slower ball on a elngth on off, David waits on it and nudges it through the vacant midwicket area. Gets two as the fielder comes in from the deep
On a length outside off, David picks out extra cover with his drive

And the impact player gets the impact player! On a length around off, SKY crouches and cuts this hard but didn't quite get under it enough. It goes hard to Arshdeep at short third and it bobs out of his hands initially as he catches this above his head and tries to bring it in control, but holds on in the second attempt
Same ball, same result! Just slightly fuller maybe on off, but makes no difference to Kishan who again hits this back over the bowler's head
Down the ground and four more. This was in the slot on off and Kishan stands still and whacks this over the bowler
And now Kishan goes big. Full on off, pace off, and Kishan waits for it before hammering this over midwicket
Full outside off, Suryakumar drives this to extra cover
SKY brings up the 100 partnership in style! This is full on middle and SKY just chips this over midwicket with ease
Digs it in shot outside off, angling across him. SKY goes for the pull but can't get any contact. This is called wide for height
Full outside off, Kishan miscues a swing down the ground to long-on
Low full toss on middle, Kishan clips this to deep backward square
Full on off and Surya whips this away to long-on
Bangs it in on a length and SKY again goes low and plays the pickup shot over backward square. Rahul Chahar again runs across from deep square to stop that from going for four
Where can you bowl to SKY? Certainly not short and wide! SKY reaches out and crouches and slashes this over backward point and gets another boundary
SKY goes for that pickup shot behind square again but Rahul Chahar runs back and stops that andthey only get two this time
Works it to deep midwicket
Full on off, Kishan meets it with the full face of the bat and Curran seems to just get something on that as it slows down en route to long-on
On a length on leg, Suryakumar flicks it wide of the midwicket fielder who gives a short chase to stop that

Fifty up in just 23 balls! On a length on middle and he flicks this off his hips behind square. Another boundary and it's his third half-century of the season. This landed just before the rope. What a lovely pickup shot
Curran comes back with a bouncer. SKY looks for the ramp but can't connect. Called wide for height!
Ouch! SKY hits this back hard at Curran and he almost gets something on it but instead the ball races down the ground and beats both long-on and long-off
SKY is turning on the style here. Curran goes full outside off and Surya gets down on one knee and drives this over cover and the ball travels 87 metres
SKY, what are you doing?! Back of a length on leg and going across him, Surya opens the face and swipes at it and it clears the rope at deep backward point!
Full on middle and off, Kishan swings this away along the ground between deep square and deep midwicket and he finishes the over with a boundary
Back of a length outside off, SKY chops it to short third and they get a quick run
Bangs it in short outside off from around the wicket, Kishan gets only glove on it as he looks to pull and it lands short of short fine despite ballooning up
Full outside off, Surya whips this out to long-on
Slower ball on a length on middle and off and going across him. Kishan adjusts late to just dab it to short third for a single
Full on middle and Kishan drives it down the ground. Long-off runs in to cut that out but Kishan gets the second and brings up his fifty off 29 deliveries
Tossed up full on leg, Kishan clips this away to deep midwicket. SKY turns down the second run
Now that was hit hard. Dropped short outside off and Kishan skips out and flat-bats this past the bowler
On a length outside off, he punches it towards point and takes a quick single
Short and wide and punished. Cuts this hard and just beats the backward point fielder and he has back-to-back boundaries
Sliced over point and it races away! Skipped out but got nowhere near the pitch of the ball but reaches out and manages to get it over the infield
Tossed up full on middle and off, SKY looks to flick this away but hits it into his foot
That's deposited into the stands! Full and wide and he gets down on one knee and slogs this over deep midwicket
On a length on off, SKY goes back and whips this away through midwicket for a single
Out of the way, Harpreet! Kishan skips out to a length ball and slaps this back past Brar and it races away
Darts it in full on leg, SKY clips it away to wide long-on
On a length outside off, Kishan pulls to wide long-on
Reverse-sweep but straight to sweeper cover. He had switched his stance early and he hit it over the infield but couldn't place it past the fielder in the deep
On a length on off, driven back to the bowler
On a length on off, Kishan pulls to deep midwicket and gets two
Tossed up full outside off, SKY comes out and whips this aerially. Lands short of the long-on fielder
Swept behind for four. Full on middle and he had moved across early and he hits this wide of short fine
Good shot, but finds the fielder. Chahar tosses this up full on middle, SKY made room and hit it hard through cover. The fielder in the deep, Short, does well to run across and stop that
Tossed up full on middle and leg, Kishan blocks it back to the bowler's left
Tossed up full outside off and Suryakumar goes for the sweep. Inside edges it onto the ground and it rolls towards backward square as the batters take the single
On a length on middle, Suryakumar clips it through the vacant midwicket area

Cuts this hard to backward point where the fielder's dive takes the sting off the shot. But he has deflected it past Arshdeep at short third and goes to the boundary. The batters pick up two despite a late call
Kishan eases this quicker length ball wide of long-on to get Surya back on strike
Leading edge clears the infield! Tossed up full on leg, SKY looks to whip it away leg-side but it goes over the cover fielder off the edge
Floats it on a length on off, Kishan waits and taps it square on the off side
Tossed up full on middle, Surya flicks it aerially to deep midwicket
Chahar drops it short again, SKY goes for the cut but this time he is beaten by the bounce
Here we go! A long hop from Chahar around off and SKY rocks back and pulls through midwicket. Deep square was running hard to his left, but that was hit hard enough to beat his dive
On a length on off, SKY hangs back and punches to backward point
Lobs it up on a length on off, Kishan punches it towards deep cover

Green picks out deep midwicket! Back of a length slower ball on middle and leg, Green makes room and looks to pull but doesn't time this at all. It's a simple catch for Rahul Chahar as Punjab Kings finish the powerplay on a high
Yorker on leg and he digs it out through midwicket. They get two as the fielder from deep square runs in to intercept
Back of a length on middle and leg, Kishan skips out and punches it to cover
On a length on leg, he swings it away to deep square leg along the ground
Full on off again, Kishan this time taps it to cover and gets a single
Starts off with a full ball on off that's going away from Kishan from over the wicket. Kishan steers it to backward point
Threads the gap! On a length on middle and leg, Green backs away and cuts it and finds the gap between backward point and short third
Good comeback from Dhawan as he beats Green with a length ball that seams away. Pitches it outside off and it straightens just a bit to go past the outside edge
Full outside off and Kishan drives it past Dhawan but mid-off cuts it out
Can't step out? No problem, says Ishan Kishan as he goes big over midwicket. This was in the slot on middle and Kishan just cleared his front leg and swung it away
Kishan hits it back down the ground but Dhawan gets his hand down to stop that from racing away. It was a length ball on middle going across him and Kishan slapped this straight and hard
High and mighty blow! Dhawan goes full on off and Kishan skips out and absolutely hammers this over long-on. It went high and landed ten rows back
In the slot and put away! Makes room and pulls this length ball away through midwicket for a one-bounce four
Full on off, going across and he swings at this again and misses this time
Slashed over third. On a length and going across him and Green frees his hands and throws his bat at this
Whipped away, but finds deep backward square. This was full on leg and Kishan looked to swing it away, but can't beat the fielder in the deep
Fuller outside off and he steers it to  point
On a length on middle, Kishan defends

Run out chance goes begging! Green slaps it to mid-off and takes off for the single but Kishan ain't moving. Green turns and runs back and gets in by the time the throw comes in and Jitesh takes the bails off
Full outside off, he punches to point and they take a quick single
Full on off, seaming in and Green backs away and hits it wide of mid-off
Slower ball on a length on off, Green backs away and slaps it in front but it goes straight to mid-off
Beats him again. Back of a length outside off and it jags in. Green again has a swipe but gets nowhere near it
Starts off this over with a beauty of a delivery. It's pitched up outside off and seams away as Green looks to swing hard
What a ball! Kishan is completely done in by this brute of a short ball as he tries to duck away but it just takes enough off the bat to go over short third and to the boundary
Swatted away for four! Full and too wide and Kishan reaches out and steers it through third

Just short of the fielder! Full on middle and leg and Green wants to go downtown again but it comes off the inside half of the bat. Curran is moving forward towards the ball but it drops just before him
Full and wide and he drives it out to deep cover
Bangs it in short of good length outside leg, Green wants to pull but the ball seams away from him. He checks his shot and the ball lobs up to the bowler's left. They scramble the single
Chips it over mid-on! Full on middle and swinging in, but Green makes room and swings it down the ground. A couple of bounces and over the rope
On a length on off and the ball angles away from Green. Too wide
Lovely stuff from Rishi Dhawan. Angles it full and across Kishan, who pushes at it but the ball seams away past his edge
Green clips it to midwicket to get off the mark
Through everything! That's full on off, jags in further as Green looks to swing at it and goes between bat and pad and past leg-stump and a flying Jitesh Sharma. Races away for dour byes

And he is gone! Picks out deep third. Rohit was skipping out and backing away towards leg, but Dhawan bowls it full outside off. Rohit reaches out but doesn't get enough bat on it and Punjab Kings have the early breakthrough without any runs on the board. Rohit's 15th duck in the IPL
Full on leg at 134kph, Rohit looks to flick but misses and it goes off his pads to the keeper's left
Squares him up first ball! It's a back of length delivery that jags in from outside off and hits Rohit high on his back thigh as he tries to play it leg-side
